items.title: 3 Founder Led Stocks To Own In November 2026
items.summary: Leadership scandals tied to national security concerns, such as the probe into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with an alleged Chinese spy, show how much can rest on a single executive. items.title: AI Chip Stocks to Watch After TSMC and Nvidia Lift Sentiment
items.summary: AI hardware and semiconductor stocks just swung from political worry to renewed excitement, as TSMC, Nvidia and their peers helped pull Asian markets off the mat and lent support to U.S. futures. For investors, that kind of sharp mood shift can quickly reprice both perceived winners and overlooked laggards.
